skills.name: odd-workflow
skills.description: Trigger: odd workflow, organic driven development, flujo odd, trabajo sustancial, odd task. Use when executing development under Gentle-AI 5.0.0 Organic Driven Development (ODD) in harnesses without native gentle-ai: authorize, explore, keep authorized work moving, classify by 3 criteria, track in odd/tasks/<feature>.md, synthesize a 5-line One-Shot Pre-Flight Blueprint, enforce parent-adjudicated Allowed Edit Surfaces and 3-tier verification in mktemp -d, commit in ~400-line reviewable slices (high-risk isolated), run Pre-Release Live CVE Gate, and close with observed evidence and Risk line. Do NOT use when gentle-ai is already active in the system prompt.

skills.name: skill-router
skills.description: Deterministic router that pre-selects which skills an agent should load, replacing ~80% of stochastic LLM-based skill selection with exact trigger matching. Outputs primary skill + secondary candidates + ODD/trivial flags. Use BEFORE any agent turn that might invoke another skill, to shrink the agent's decision surface from 258 skills to 3-5.

skills.name: skill-loader
skills.description: Tier 0/1 enforcement for the skills catalog. Caches skill frontmatter with mtime, emits tier0-context.json (9 always-on skills) on first run, and per-turn emits tier1-instructions.txt with ONLY the bodies of skills the router selected via tier1toLoad[]. Enforces the \"route first\" rule: a skill outside the current tier1toLoad must be re-routed before being read. Use at agent boot to bootstrap tier-0 context, and at every turn before reading another skill's body.

skills.name: skill-validator
skills.description: Validates that all SKILL.md files in the catalog comply with the agentskills.io specification. Checks name constraints, description length, frontmatter structure, and folder-name matching. Exits non-zero on any failure. Use in pre-commit hooks, CI pipelines, or before publishing a skill catalog.

skills.name: testing-patterns
skills.description: Unit, integration, and E2E testing patterns for fullstack apps — fast deterministic unit tests vs ephemeral-database integration tests (PGlite, Testcontainers, SQLite in-memory). Use when writing tests with Vitest, Supertest, or React Testing Library. Do NOT use for penetration testing or security audits.

skills.name: code-reviewer
skills.description: Trigger: code reviewer, review, code review, PR review, verification loop, audit code. Conduct a rigorous, causal code review using the 4R Framework, Gentle-AI 5.0.0 proportionate review rules (Provider Contract 1.6.0), and ECC verification loops. Use before committing, before PR creation, or during High-Risk (1-6) verification. Do NOT use to mutate code during a read-only review pass.

skills.name: engram-integration
skills.description: Persistent cross-session memory for AI coding agents via the Engram binary — one-liner setup (engram setup <agent>), 20 MCP tools (mem_save/mem_search/mem_judge...), SQLite+FTS5, git sync, optional cloud. Use when an agent should remember decisions and bugs across sessions instead of starting over.

skills.name: dod-checker
skills.description: Act as the strict Gatekeeper for the Definition of Done (DoD). Use when evaluating whether a feature or task is ready to close. Blocks checkoffs if SOLID, DRY, architectural proportionality, or 2026 security guardrails are bypassed. Do not use for initial feature planning.

skills.name: decision-gate
skills.description: Decision-support system that compresses the human's last-20% judgment from 30 min to 3 min. Presents trade-offs as an ordered matrix, surfaces conflicts with prior decisions (via Engram), offers safe defaults to override, and records the decision + reasoning in Engram. Use when judgment-day or a PRD leaves a decision the human must make and you want it fast, well-informed, and traceable.
